title: JSON number parser silently misreads valid positive exponents
summary: The numeric token state accepts e/E and minus but omits plus. A current-source parser linked with a capture-only indigo_change_property substitute parsed 100 as 100 and 1e-2 as 0.01, but valid JSON 1e+2 as 1. This silently changes requested values. Accept the complete JSON numeric grammar and reject malformed/truncated tokens; add both exponent-sign regressions.
